Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: Misread key details—most directly, used 0.25 lb per potato instead of the stated 0.5 lb, halving the total weight and yielding 1 bag instead of the correct 2. Also miscounted attendees and misapplied the “second cousins don’t eat carbs” rule (counted all six kids and treated the great-uncle’s daughter as a second cousin), but the weight-per-potato error directly caused the wrong bag count.
